description: This file defines utility functions and declarations for working with MLIR operations within the TensorFlow DTensor framework. It includes functions for manipulating operation layouts, finding functions, generating hashes and names for operations, and managing constants in MLIR modules.

methods.name: OpHash
methods.description: Computes a deterministic hash of a given MLIR operation.

methods.name: std::string OpName(mlir::Operation * op)
methods.description: Returns the string name of an MLIR operation.

methods.name: std::string GetFullOpName(const std::string & name)
methods.description: Prefixes a given operation name with 'tf.' to generate a full operation name.

methods.name: MaybeFindFunction
methods.description: Finds and returns a callable function (mlir::func::FuncOp) associated with an MLIR operation, if any.

methods.name: RemoveDTensorLayoutOps
methods.description: Removes DTensor layout operations from the MLIR module, optionally preserving layouts with use_xla_spmd=True.

methods.name: ReplaceAuxiliaryDTensorLayoutOpsWithIdentity
methods.description: Replaces redundant DTensorLayout ops with identity ops in the MLIR module.

methods.name: DuplicateConstants
methods.description: Clones constant ops with multiple usages to ensure each has at most one usage.

methods.name: GetOperationName
methods.description: Constructs a string name for an MLIR operation based on the module.
